policy: AGENTS.md, documents/agents/orchestrator-policy.md, documents/lessons.md, documents/rounds/README.md, .github/merge-policy.md, and every markdown file in the canonical orchestrator skill (~/.agents/skills/orchestrator/) are review-gated: a change is reviewed by deepseek-v4-pro build 0813 first (glm-5.3 only when no provider answers with 0813, with the unavailability stated in fallbackReason), judged against the reason recorded here, which names what changes, why now, and what was rejected. tests/meta/protected-doc-review.test.ts recomputes each sha256 (CRLF to LF, trailing whitespace trimmed, leading BOM dropped) and fails when the text moved after review, the reviewer is not the first choice, a fallback lacks a reason, an entry is orphaned, or a protected file is missing.
